XI Mixed multitude ... .yearn for onions, garlic, etc (xi-4-6)
XIII Josue and Caleb the only two of all the "spies" who went into Chanaan, the Promised land.

XIX Sacrifice of the Red Cow ....

XXXV ... Suburb Cities of Refuge ..... Laws of vengence.
XXXVI Marriage in one's own tribe stres'd

I The people murmur and are punished for 40 years.
III None except Josue who succeeds Moses and Caleb reach the Prom- ised Land. Moses himself is sent to the top of Mt. Phasga to get a view thereof but is not to enter thither.
